node.description: The node name from config. The control plane may return a different durable name; the node adopts what it is told.

role.description: CLOSED set. It decides which desired-state fields the control plane may send.

version.description: The tmesis version string, so a control plane can refuse to enroll a build it cannot drive.

capabilities.description: Feature name to whether this build has it. A key the control plane does not know is ignored, never an error.

rtmp.description: host:port, empty when the listener is off

srt.description: host:port, empty when the listener is off
